title: The Lean Founder Playbook
author: Marcus Hale
short: Turn a small idea into a profitable business without wasting money.
description: A step-by-step guide to testing ideas, finding first customers and growing on a tight budget. Includes checklists for pricing, validation and simple financial planning.

title: Meetings That Matter
author: Olivia Barnes
short: Run shorter meetings that end with clear decisions.
description: Practical formats for stand-ups, planning sessions and reviews. Learn how to prepare an agenda, keep discussions on track and follow up effectively.

title: Selling Without Pressure
author: Daniel Okafor
short: An honest, friendly approach to sales conversations.
description: Learn how to listen, ask better questions and present your offer in a way customers trust. Ideal for freelancers and small business owners.

title: The Remote Team Handbook
author: Priya Raman
short: Build a happy, productive team that works from anywhere.
description: Hiring, onboarding, communication and culture for distributed teams. Includes templates for weekly updates and one-to-one meetings.

title: Brand Basics for Small Business
author: Lena Fischer
short: Create a clear, memorable brand on a small budget.
description: Define your message, choose colours and fonts, and stay consistent across your website, social media and packaging.

title: The Art of Saying No
author: Hannah Moore
short: Protect your time and energy without feeling guilty.
description: Simple scripts and mindset shifts for setting boundaries at work and at home, so you can focus on what really matters.

title: Deep Focus in a Noisy World
author: Samuel Price
short: Train your attention for long, distraction-free work.
description: Techniques for managing notifications, planning focus blocks and building a work environment that helps you concentrate.

title: The Sunday Planning Habit
author: Clara Jensen
short: Thirty minutes every Sunday for a calmer week.
description: A weekly review routine that helps you set priorities, schedule key tasks and start Monday with confidence.

title: Digital Declutter
author: Owen Patel
short: Tidy your inbox, files and phone in one weekend.
description: A practical plan for organising digital life: email rules, folder systems, photo backups and a lighter phone home screen.

title: Habits That Stick
author: Isabel Wright
short: Small daily changes that add up to big results.
description: Understand how habits form, design routines that fit your life and recover quickly when you miss a day.

title: JavaScript from Scratch
author: Ethan Brooks
short: A friendly introduction to modern JavaScript.
description: Variables, functions, arrays and the browser explained with clear examples. Build three small interactive projects as you learn.

title: Spreadsheets Made Easy
author: Grace Liu
short: Formulas, charts and tables for everyday tasks.
description: From budgets to project trackers, learn the spreadsheet skills that save hours every week, with step-by-step exercises.

title: Cyber Safety at Home
author: Nathan Cole
short: Protect your family's devices and accounts.
description: Strong passwords, two-step verification, safe browsing and what to do if an account is hacked, explained in plain English.

title: Build Your First Website
author: Sofia Martins
short: Plan, design and publish a simple website.
description: HTML and CSS basics, choosing a host, and making your site fast and mobile-friendly. No previous experience needed.

title: Data Skills for Beginners
author: Arjun Mehta
short: Read, clean and present data with confidence.
description: Learn how to ask good questions of data, spot common mistakes and create clear charts that tell a story.

title: The Island Letters
author: Eleanor Hayes
short: A storm, a secret and a family that must decide what to forgive.
description: On a remote island, Maggie discovers letters that change everything she knew about her father. A moving novel about loyalty and second chances.

title: Midnight at the Northern Line
author: Tom Ashford
short: A fast-paced mystery on the last train home.
description: When a passenger vanishes between two stations, a tired detective has until morning to find out who is lying.

title: The Orchard Summer
author: Rosa Delgado
short: Three friends, one summer and the farm that brings them back together.
description: A warm, gentle story about growing up, leaving home and finding your way back to the people who matter.

title: Signals from Kepler
author: Jonah Reed
short: A science-fiction adventure about humanity's first reply.
description: When an old radio telescope picks up a message, a young engineer must decide whether Earth should answer.

title: The Corner Bookshop Year
author: Amelia Grant
short: A cosy tale of community, books and starting over.
description: When Nora inherits a failing bookshop, she has one year to bring it back to life with the help of some unlikely neighbours.

title: Strength Training for Beginners
author: Lucas Romero
short: Get stronger safely with three short sessions a week.
description: Clear exercise guides, warm-up routines and a twelve-week plan you can follow at home or in the gym.

title: Sleep Better Tonight
author: Maya Collins
short: Simple evening habits for deeper, more restful sleep.
description: Understand your sleep cycle, create a calming routine and fix the common habits that keep you awake.

title: The 10-Minute Stretch
author: Kenji Watanabe
short: Daily stretches for desk workers and busy people.

title: Eat Well, Feel Well
author: Chloe Bennett
short: Balanced eating without strict diets.
description: Easy guidelines for building balanced meals, reading food labels and enjoying treats without guilt.

title: Calm in Five Breaths
author: Aisha Karim
short: Quick breathing techniques for stressful moments.
description: Short exercises you can use before a meeting, an exam or a difficult conversation to feel calm and focused.

title: Budgeting for Real Life
author: Peter Lawson
short: A flexible budget you can actually stick to.
description: Track spending, plan for irregular bills and build savings goals that fit your income and lifestyle.

title: Investing Explained Simply
author: Natalie Ross
short: Understand shares, funds and risk in plain language.
description: How investing works, the difference between common investment types and how to start with small amounts. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: Debt-Free in Three Years
author: Robert Hughes
short: A step-by-step plan to pay off what you owe.
description: Compare repayment strategies, talk to lenders with confidence and stay motivated until the last payment.

title: The Freelancer's Money Guide
author: Julia Novak
short: Manage irregular income, taxes and savings.
description: Set your rates, separate business and personal money, and plan ahead for quiet months and tax deadlines.

title: Saving for Your First Home
author: Adam Clarke
short: Plan your deposit and understand the buying process.
description: Set a savings target, improve your credit profile and learn the key steps from viewing to moving in.

title: One-Pot Weeknight Dinners
author: Laura Bianchi
short: Thirty easy recipes with less washing up.
description: Hearty stews, pastas and rice dishes made in a single pot, ready in about thirty minutes.

title: The Home Baker's Guide
author: Emily Turner
short: Bread, cakes and pastries made simple.
description: Learn the basics of dough, oven temperatures and decorating, with forty tested recipes for beginners.

title: Plant-Based for Everyone
author: Noah Fernandes
short: Colourful vegetarian meals the whole family will enjoy.
description: Simple swaps, protein-rich dishes and meal-prep ideas for anyone who wants to eat more vegetables.

title: Spice Route Kitchen
author: Farah Siddiqui
short: Bold flavours from simple spice blends.
description: Learn to toast, grind and combine spices to create curries, marinades and rubs at home.

title: Lunchbox Ideas
author: Megan Price
short: Healthy packed lunches for school and work.
description: Fifty no-fuss lunchbox ideas, a weekly prep plan and tips for keeping food fresh until lunchtime.

title: Travel Light
author: Oscar Lindqvist
short: Pack everything you need in one small bag.
description: Packing lists, clever folding methods and the essentials for city breaks, business trips and long journeys.

title: The Budget Traveller
author: Zoe Mitchell
short: See more of the world while spending less.
description: Find cheaper flights, choose affordable stays and plan routes that save both money and time.

title: Slow Travel Europe
author: Henri Dubois
short: Rail journeys and small towns off the usual path.
description: Itineraries for unhurried travel by train, with tips on local food, quiet villages and seasonal events.

title: Weekend Hikes for Beginners
author: Liam O'Connor
short: Plan safe, enjoyable day hikes.
description: Choose the right trail, pack the essentials, read a map and check the weather before you set out.

title: The Family Road Trip
author: Sara Lindgren
short: Stress-free road trips with children.
description: Route planning, games for the car, snack ideas and how to build in breaks that keep everyone happy.

title: Public Speaking Without Fear
author: Victoria Hall
short: Speak clearly and confidently in any room.
description: Prepare talks that flow, manage nerves and handle questions, from team meetings to conference stages.

title: Python for Everyday Automation
author: Diego Alvarez
short: Let small scripts handle your repetitive tasks.
description: Rename files, fill spreadsheets and send reports automatically. Each chapter ends with a ready-to-use script.

title: The Quiet Detective
author: Margaret Doyle
short: A retired librarian solves a village mystery.
description: When a valuable map disappears from the local museum, Edith uses her eye for detail to uncover the truth.

title: The Five-Minute Morning Journal
author: Ruth Adams
short: A simple journaling practice for clearer thinking.
description: Prompts and routines to help you write every morning, reduce stress and find new ideas.
